title: February 1st - 20th, Exam Sketch
overview: Deals with Sae and Hiro's college entrance exams, and particularly Hiro's stress over waiting for the results.

title: February 28 - March 1, Graduation Sketch
overview: Covers preparations for the graduation ceremony, followed by the ceremony itself. It also features a pronounced flashback to the first time Hiro and Sae met as first-years.
